Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. nutrition (n)
/njuˈtrɪʃn/
sự dinh dưỡng, chất dinh dưỡng
Collocation: good nutrition, poor nutrition
"Proper nutrition is essential for children's physical growth and brain development."
2. balanced (adj)
/ˈbælənst/
cân bằng, điều độ
Collocation: a balanced diet, balanced lifestyle
"Eating a balanced diet with fresh vegetables keeps your body strong."
3. obesity (n)
/əʊˈbiːsəti/
bệnh béo phì, tình trạng thừa cân nặng
Collocation: childhood obesity, prevent obesity
"Consuming too much fast food increases the risk of childhood obesity."
4. stamina (n)
/ˈstæmɪnə/
sức bền, sự dẻo dai
Collocation: build stamina, physical stamina
"Long-distance swimming helps athletes build incredible physical stamina."
5. mental (adj)
/ˈmentl/
thuộc về tinh thần, tâm lý
Collocation: mental health, mental wellbeing
"Outdoor recreation is just as important for mental health as it is for the body."
6. recreation (n)
/ˌrekriˈeɪʃn/
hoạt động giải trí, thư giãn
Collocation: outdoor recreation, recreation center
"Cycling and hiking are popular forms of weekend outdoor recreation."
7. sedentary (adj)
/ˈsedntri/
ít vận động, ngồi nhiều một chỗ
Collocation: sedentary lifestyle, sedentary office job
"Office workers often suffer from back pain due to a sedentary lifestyle."
8. workout (n)
/ˈwɜːkaʊt/
buổi tập luyện thể chất
Collocation: daily workout, morning workout session
"A 30-minute morning workout gives you abundant energy for the whole day."
9. immunity (n)
/ɪˈmjuːnəti/
hệ miễn dịch, sức đề kháng
Collocation: boost immunity, natural immunity
"Vitamin C and regular sleep help boost your natural immunity against flu."
10. beneficial (adj)
/ˌbenɪˈfɪʃl/
có lợi, mang lại lợi ích tích cực
Collocation: highly beneficial to health, mutually beneficial
"Morning yoga is highly beneficial to both posture and mental focus."
11. consume (v)
/kənˈsjuːm/
tiêu thụ, ăn uống nạp vào cơ thể
Collocation: consume calories, consume fresh fruit
"Doctors advise people not to consume sugary soft drinks every day."
12. wellbeing (n)
/ˈwelbiːɪŋ/
sự khỏe mạnh, trạng thái hạnh phúc toàn diện
Collocation: emotional wellbeing, overall wellbeing
"Adequate sleep is fundamental to a student's overall wellbeing."
13. prevent (v)
/prɪˈvent/
ngăn ngừa, phòng tránh bệnh tật
Collocation: prevent heart disease, prevent injury
"Warming up before sports helps prevent serious muscle injuries."
14. diet (n)
/ˈdaɪət/
chế độ ăn uống hàng ngày
Collocation: healthy diet, plant-based diet
"A traditional Mediterranean diet is rich in olive oil, fish, and nuts."
15. stress (n)
/stres/
sự căng thẳng, áp lực tâm lý
Collocation: relieve stress, academic stress
"Playing team sports after class is an effective way to relieve academic stress."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Căn Bản (Danh Từ Đếm Được/Không Đếm Được & Lượng Từ)

• Danh từ đếm được (Countable) vs Không đếm được (Uncountable):
  - Countable: workout, vegetable, calorie, vitamin (có số nhiều -s).
  - Uncountable: nutrition, stamina, stress, wellbeing, obesity, advice, information (luôn chia động từ số ít, không thêm -s).

• Lượng từ (Quantifiers):
  - many / a few + Danh từ đếm được số nhiều (many workouts, a few calories).
  - much / a little + Danh từ không đếm được (much stress, a little sugar).
  - a lot of / plenty of + Cả hai loại danh từ.

• Động từ khuyết thiếu chỉ lời khuyên & bắt buộc (Modals): should / ought to + V-bare (khuyên nên làm); must / have to + V-bare (bắt buộc phải làm).

🔵 Tầng 2: Nâng Cao (Cấu Trúc Đưa Giải Pháp Task 2 & Danh Động Từ)

• Làm chủ ngữ bằng V-ing (Gerund Phrases as Subjects): Thay vì viết 'If people exercise...', hãy dùng cụm V-ing đứng đầu câu (chia động từ số ít) để câu văn đạt chuẩn Band 6.5+:
  Ví dụ: Maintaining a balanced diet is essential for preventing obesity.

• Cấu trúc khuyên nhủ học thuật (Academic Advice): Thay vì dùng should lặp lại nhiều lần, hãy nâng cấp thành: It is crucial / advisable for citizens to + V-bare.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. Eating a ________ diet with vegetables, protein, and whole grains keeps your body energized.
2. Many office workers suffer from neck and back pain because of their ________ lifestyle.
3. Marathon runners train for months to build their physical ________ and endurance.
4. Eating too much junk food and sugary snacks is a major cause of childhood ________.
5. Getting eight hours of sleep and eating citrus fruits can naturally boost your ________.
6. Swimming and cycling are highly ________ to cardiovascular health.
7. Nutritionists advise teenagers not to ________ too many carbonated soft drinks.
8. Stretching for ten minutes before a football match helps ________ muscle injuries.
9. Listening to classical music or walking in nature helps students relieve exam ________.
10. Good ________ during childhood lays the foundation for lifelong health.
11. Meditation and mindfulness exercises improve both physical and ________ health.
12. The new community park provides generous space for outdoor ________ and family picnics.
13. I always complete a 40-minute gym ________ before starting my university classes.
14. Employers are introducing flexible hours to support their staff's emotional ________.
15. Switching to a plant-based ________ rich in fiber can lower cholesterol levels.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 1] Going for a morning jog has become an essential part of my daily ________.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 2] Regular physical exercise helps students ________ better during long lectures.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 2] Sticking to a daily workout plan requires strong personal ________.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 3] Clean air and green parks in ________ areas encourage residents to jog outdoors.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 3] Cycling to work not only improves fitness but also reduces carbon ________.

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. How ________ refined sugar do you consume in your coffee every day?
2. Doing a 30-minute workout every morning ________ highly beneficial to your heart.
3. If you want to prevent back pain, you ________ sit at your computer for six hours without a break.
4. Only ________ students in our class bring home-cooked lunches, while most buy fast food.
5. Proper nutrition ________ a vital role in boosting children's natural immunity.
6. Professional athletes ________ follow a strict training schedule to maintain their stamina.
7. Adding ________ olive oil and fresh herbs makes a salad both tasty and healthy.
8. Too ________ academic stress can negatively affect a student's sleep and mental wellbeing.
9. ________ team sports on weekends helps teenagers build social skills and relieve tension.
10. The fitness coach gave me some very useful ________ on how to prevent knee injuries.

Tốc độ đọc:
Trạng thái: Sẵn sàng phát Câu: 0 / 15
💡 Bấm vào bất kỳ câu thoại nào để nghe riêng câu đó:
Coach: Good afternoon! Welcome to the Campus Wellness & Fitness Center. How can I help you achieve your health goals?
Student: Hi Coach! Lately, I've had a very sedentary routine because of exam revision, and I feel tired all the time.
Coach: I completely understand. Let's fill out a quick wellness assessment. What is your main fitness priority right now?
Student: I really want to build my physical stamina and relieve academic stress. 💡 Đáp án câu 1: stamina
Coach: Great goal. For beginners, I recommend our Cardio Swimming class on Monday and Wednesday evenings. 💡 Đáp án câu 2: swimming / Cardio Swimming
Student: How long is each workout session in the pool?
Coach: Each session lasts 45 minutes, including a 10-minute warm-up to prevent muscle injuries. 💡 Đáp án câu 3: 45 minutes
Student: That sounds manageable! Do you also offer advice on daily nutrition and diet?
Coach: Yes! Our sports nutritionist holds a workshop every Friday on preparing a balanced diet. 💡 Đáp án câu 4: Friday
Student: What is the most important dietary change I should make first?
Coach: You should reduce refined sugar and consume more protein and fresh vegetables to boost your immunity. 💡 Đáp án câu 5: sugar / refined sugar
Student: How much is the monthly student membership for both the gym and swimming pool?
Coach: For full-time undergraduates, the all-access wellness pass is 25 pounds per month. 💡 Đáp án câu 6: 25 pounds / 25
Student: Wonderful! I'd like to sign up starting this Monday.
Coach: Fantastic decision! Let's get your membership card printed right away.
Điểm: 0/6

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - The Modern Sedentary Crisis]
In the twenty-first century, technological convenience has led millions of people into a sedentary lifestyle. Students and office workers spend over eight hours a day sitting in front of digital screens. At the same time, many people consume processed fast food instead of a balanced diet. This combination of poor nutrition and physical inactivity has caused a sharp rise in obesity and weakened natural immunity.

[Paragraph B - Physical Stamina & Disease Prevention]
Health scientists emphasize that regular physical activity is the most effective way to prevent chronic illness. Engaging in a 30-minute daily workout—such as brisk walking, swimming, or cycling—strengthens the heart and builds physical stamina. Even moderate exercise is highly beneficial because it burns excess calories and regulates blood pressure.

[Paragraph C - Outdoor Recreation & Mental Wellbeing]
Beyond physical fitness, active leisure and outdoor recreation play a vital role in protecting mental health. Participating in team sports or weekend hiking helps young adults relieve work and academic stress. When individuals combine nutritious meals with enjoyable exercise, they achieve lasting emotional and physical wellbeing.
Điểm: 0/6
